plugins.name: basedpyright-lsp
plugins.description: Basedpyright Python language server (stricter pyright fork). uvx / pipx run fallback.

plugins.name: bash-lsp
plugins.description: bash-language-server for shell scripts. bunx / pnpm dlx / npx fallback. Integrates with shellcheck when present on PATH.

plugins.name: biome-formatter
plugins.description: Auto-format JS / TS / JSON with Biome after Claude writes them. PostToolUse hook; bunx / pnpm dlx / npx fallback. Pairs with prettier-formatter, which covers CSS/HTML/Markdown/YAML.

plugins.name: biome-lsp
plugins.description: Biome language server (lsp-proxy) for JS / TS / JSX / TSX / JSON / JSONC / CSS / GraphQL. bunx / pnpm dlx / npx fallback.

plugins.name: clangd-lsp
plugins.description: clangd C/C++ language server. Requires clangd on PATH — no npm/PyPI package to fall back through.

plugins.name: context7
plugins.description: Upstash Context7 MCP server for up-to-date documentation lookup. Remote streamable-HTTP transport at mcp.context7.com — no local runtime, no auth required for the free tier.

plugins.name: csharp-lsp
plugins.description: csharp-ls C# language server. Requires the csharp-ls .NET tool on PATH — no npm/PyPI package to fall back through.

plugins.name: deepwiki
plugins.description: Devin DeepWiki MCP server for AI-grounded Q&A over any public GitHub repository's wiki. Remote HTTP transport, no auth.

plugins.name: gopls-lsp
plugins.description: gopls Go language server. Requires the gopls binary on PATH — no npm/PyPI package to fall back through.

plugins.name: jdtls-lsp
plugins.description: Eclipse JDT.LS Java language server. Requires the jdtls launcher on PATH and a JDK — no npm/PyPI package to fall back through.

plugins.name: kotlin-lsp
plugins.description: JetBrains kotlin-lsp Kotlin language server. Requires the kotlin-lsp binary on PATH — no npm/PyPI package to fall back through.

plugins.name: languages-pack
plugins.description: All-in-one bundle of this marketplace's non-overlapping language servers (biome, vscode-html, bash, basedpyright, tombi, yaml) and formatter hooks (biome, prettier, ruff). One install for broad multi-language coverage.

plugins.name: liquid-lsp
plugins.description: Shopify Liquid template language server (Shopify CLI `theme language-server`). bunx / pnpm dlx / npx fallback.

plugins.name: lua-lsp
plugins.description: lua-language-server Lua language server. Requires the lua-language-server binary on PATH — no npm/PyPI package to fall back through.

plugins.name: php-lsp
plugins.description: Intelephense PHP language server. bunx / pnpm dlx / npx fallback.

plugins.name: prettier-formatter
plugins.description: Auto-format CSS / HTML / Markdown / YAML with Prettier after Claude writes them. PostToolUse hook; bunx / pnpm dlx / npx fallback. Pairs with biome-formatter, which covers JS/TS/JSON.

plugins.name: ruby-lsp
plugins.description: Shopify ruby-lsp Ruby language server. Requires the ruby-lsp gem on PATH — no npm/PyPI package to fall back through.

plugins.name: ruff-formatter
plugins.description: Auto-format Python files with ruff after Claude writes them. PostToolUse hook; uvx / pipx run fallback.

plugins.name: rust-analyzer-lsp
plugins.description: rust-analyzer Rust language server. Requires the rust-analyzer binary on PATH — no npm/PyPI package to fall back through.

plugins.name: swift-lsp
plugins.description: SourceKit-LSP Swift language server. Requires sourcekit-lsp (bundled with a Swift toolchain) on PATH — no npm/PyPI package to fall back through.

plugins.name: tombi-lsp
plugins.description: Tombi TOML language server (schema-aware; Helix uses it by default). uvx / pipx run fallback.

plugins.name: typescript-lsp
plugins.description: typescript-language-server for TypeScript / JavaScript. bunx / pnpm dlx / npx fallback, pulls the typescript peer dep fresh.

plugins.name: vscode-css-lsp
plugins.description: VS Code CSS / SCSS / Less language server (from vscode-langservers-extracted). bunx / pnpm dlx / npx fallback.

plugins.name: vscode-html-lsp
plugins.description: VS Code HTML language server (from vscode-langservers-extracted). bunx / pnpm dlx / npx fallback.

plugins.name: vscode-json-lsp
plugins.description: VS Code JSON / JSONC language server (from vscode-langservers-extracted). bunx / pnpm dlx / npx fallback. Overlaps biome-lsp on .json/.jsonc.

plugins.name: yaml-lsp
plugins.description: yaml-language-server with built-in schema catalog (GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, docker-compose). bunx / pnpm dlx / npx fallback.
